subject: plotting node labels on a circular tree

messages.author: e653eb797a0bfda9
messages.subject: plotting node labels on a circular tree
parts:
Hello, 

I would like to plot bootstrap values on the nodes of a circular tree but I haven't been able to get geom_nodelab2 to work as I expected. 

Below is some example code to produce a normal tree with node labels, a circular tree with node labels using geom_nodelab2 and a manual work around using geom_text2.

Am I using geom_nodelab2 incorrectly? If not, is there a more eloquent way of doing this? 

Best wishes
Ollie

# generate tree
set.seed(1234)
tree <- rtree(n=10)

# plot as normal tree with node labels
p <- ggtree(tree)

p + geom_tiplab(aes(label=label)) +
  geom_nodelab(aes(label=node))

# plot as circular tree with node labels
p2 <- ggtree(tree, layout="circular")

# node labels not shown as expected here
p2 + geom_tiplab2(aes(label=label)) +
  geom_nodelab2(aes(label=node))


# node label upside down on left hand side 
p2 + geom_text2(aes(label=node, angle=angle))

# manually adjust the angle values
p2$data [ p2$data$angle > 90 & p2$data$angle < 180 , ]$angle   <- p2$data [ p2$data$angle > 90 & p2$data$angle < 180 , ]$angle + 180
p2$data [ p2$data$angle > 180 & p2$data$angle < 270 , ]$angle  <- p2$data [ p2$data$angle > 180 & p2$data$angle < 270 , ]$angle - 180

# as expected
p2 + geom_text2(aes(label=node, angle=angle))

messages.subject: Re: plotting node labels on a circular tree
parts:
In recent version of ggtree, the following code should works:

p2 + geom_tiplab(aes(label=label)) +
geom_nodelab(aes(label=node))
